_about: Public-domain Roger Williams (c.1603-1683), founder of Providence and champion of liberty of conscience, for the Word Hoard: the six volumes of the Narragansett Club Publications (Providence, 1866-1874: the Key into the Language of America, the Bloudy Tenent, the Bloody Tenent yet More Bloody, George Fox Digg'd out of his Burrowes and his Letters, with Cotton's replies), the Key of 1643, the Bloody Tenent yet More Bloody of 1652, Underhill's Hanserd Knollys edition of the Bloudy Tenent (1848) and Experiments of Spiritual Life & Health (1652, reprinted 1863), from Internet Archive scans and Gutenberg. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 39 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

rwilliams-pg-bloudy-tenent-1848: The Bloudy Tenent of Persecution, ed. Edward Bean Underhill for the Hanserd Knollys Society (London, 1848)
rwilliams-pg-experiments-1863: Experiments of Spiritual Life & Health (1652; reprinted Providence: Sidney S. Rider, 1863)

rwilliams-narragansett-1: Publications of the Narragansett Club, First Series, vol. I (Providence, MDCCCLXVI)

rwilliams-narragansett-3: Publications of the Narragansett Club, vol. III, The Bloudy Tenent of Persecution, ed. Samuel L. Caldwell (Providence, MDCCCLXVII)
rwilliams-narragansett-4: Publications of the Narragansett Club, vol. IV, The Bloody Tenent yet More Bloody, ed. Samuel L. Caldwell (Providence, MDCCCLXX)
rwilliams-narragansett-5: Publications of the Narragansett Club, vol. V, George Fox Digg'd out of his Burrowes, ed. J. Lewis Diman (Providence, MDCCCLXXII)
rwilliams-narragansett-6: Publications of the Narragansett Club, vol. VI, Letters of Roger Williams, ed. John Russell Bartlett (Providence, MDCCCLXXIV)
rwilliams-key-1643: A Key into the Language of America (London: Gregory Dexter, 1643)
